proposals.name: The Slant Light
proposals.why: We each tell one truth at a slant, and the whole panel is the single low light that falls across the room and shows every design its true shape.

proposals.name: Pressed Hours
proposals.why: A flower is pressed one at a time and kept true, and this panel presses each decision through its long night hours until only the essential shape remains.

proposals.name: A Herbarium of Nights
proposals.why: The herbarium is the old way of keeping every small thing true, and this panel is one such book, each guardian pressed flat and labeled, shown plainly to anyone who opens it.
